title: Campfire Buffs
description: Bring Warmth and Power to Your Players!
body:
![Campfire Main](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c9f7141da5ff330ddea5a1b908840cc9d25c5cf_0.webp)

Make campfires more than decoration!

With Campfire Buffs, players who stand or sit near a lit campfire gain temporary potion effects — perfect for survival, RPG, or roleplay servers that want immersive rest mechanics.


Current Features
Proximity-based Buffs
Players receive configurable potion effects (like Regeneration, Saturation, or Luck) after standing near a campfire for a few seconds.

Fully Configurable
Edit everything in config.yml!
- Buff types and durations
- Radius and time to activate
- Cooldown between buffs
- Particle effects and messages

Immersive Gameplay
Great for creating rest areas, inns, or warm spots during cold adventures.

Lightweight & Lag-Free
Designed with performance in mind. No unnecessary background checks.

Upcoming Features
Buff tiers
Night-only option
Custom sounds
Cooldown placeholders
Fuels and decay

Example Use Cases

️Survival servers
Rest at night to recover before continuing your journey

RPG servers
Let mages regain mana or stamina when near magical campfires

Roleplay towns
Create inns where players can warm up and get helpful boosts
